test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 4 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If 'A + B' means 'A is daughter of B', 'A - B' means 'A is wife of B', 'A × B' means 'A is the son of B', If P × Q - S then which of the following is true?

options.text: Q is the father of P
P is a daughter of Q
S is the father of P

solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/900b05d6518cb6f6bb73f03dcebf0a654dd030242b70b57f41fa5bdac9c07d49.png]

P × Q - S → P is son of Q and Q is wife of S

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b6d9003d7587a8ff10c537d205e3d10d62c0564bcf645120fb7bbe96a75fb2b3.png] 

Clearly, S is the father of P.

Hence, ‘**S is the father of P**’ is the correct answer.
